description: This file defines the CameraCaptureManager class which manages camera device interactions including listing devices, capturing images (snap), and recording video clips (clip). It handles permissions, camera selection, image processing (rotation, scaling), and video recording lifecycle.

classes.name: CameraCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages camera device operations such as listing camera devices, capturing images, and recording videos, along with permission handling and device selection.

methods.name: attachLifecycleOwner
methods.description: Attaches a lifecycle owner to the camera manager for lifecycle-aware camera binding.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a permission requester to handle runtime permission requests.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists available camera devices with their info.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo based on provided parameters, processing and returning image data.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip based on provided parameters, managing the recording lifecycle and returning file info.

methods.name: rotateBitmapByExif
methods.description: Rotates a bitmap image according to its EXIF orientation data.

methods.name: parseFacing
methods.description: Parses the facing direction ('front' or 'back') from parameters.

methods.name: parseMaxWidth
methods.description: Parses maximum width for the image from parameters.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses clip duration in milliseconds from parameters.

methods.name: parseDeviceId
methods.description: Parses specific device ID from parameters.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Determines if audio should be included in video recording from parameters.

methods.name: resolveCameraSelector
methods.description: Resolves and returns appropriate CameraSelector based on device ID and facing.

methods.name: cameraDeviceInfoOrNull
methods.description: Extracts camera device info from CameraInfo object.

methods.name: cameraIdOrNull
methods.description: Extracts camera ID string from CameraInfo object.
